title: How Do People Challenge Racial Stereotypes Online? Counter-Story Detection Across Reddit Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying posts containing racial stereotypes (focusing on Black, Asian, and Hispanic groups) on Reddit using a combination of a race lexicon, a concept-carrier semantic filter based on Sentence-BERT embeddings, and LLM-assisted classification, followed by the detection of counter-story replies.

Evaluating specific race-by-gender intersectional stereotypes (e.g., Asian-male emasculation, Asian-female fetishization, Black hypersexualization, Hispanic machismo) using the carrier-sentence method to detect them via semantic similarity filtering.
